title: Affine-local criterion for geometric irreducibility on an irreducible scheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $X$ an irreducible $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base, def-weil-irreducible-components]. Then $X$ is geometrically irreducible over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] if and only if, for every nonempty affine open subscheme $U\subseteq X$ [def-pc-scheme], the affine $k$-scheme $\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with the $k$-algebra structure induced from $X$, is geometrically irreducible over $k$. Moreover, if $X$ is geometrically irreducible, every nonempty open subscheme of $X$ is geometrically irreducible over $k$. No reducedness, quasi-compactness or finite-type hypothesis is imposed.
